method: manual source review via the live EURES public JSON API (https://europa.eu/eures/api/jv-searchengine/public/jv/id/{source_id}): each posting fetched live, stored title compared against the live title, and the live body read for role confirmation before translation. Not model output. Two candidates in this window returned HTTP 404 on the live API (uid 0c10c84afe31213a AT Zusteller:in und Lagerhelfer:in, uid 0dad6f50ad84127b FR Magasinier #SEB26) and were held, joining the still-held French posting 00cfb0e9af186fce. One candidate (uid 0dd9823824df961e) carried the legacy partial-AR marker; its fill uses the reviewed-overwrite path (4e0c799) with overwrite:true so the reviewed Arabic replaces the marker.
